name: rate-limiting-throttling-strategy
description: Design rate-limiting + throttling + backpressure strategy. Algorithms (fixed window / sliding window / token bucket / leaky bucket / concurrency limits), enforcement layers (CDN / API gateway / service / DB), scope (per-IP / per-API-key / per-user / per-tenant / global), response contract (429 + Retry-After + RateLimit-* headers per IETF draft), tier + quota model, burst handling, fair queueing, backpressure propagation, circuit breaker + bulkhead + shed-load. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
